This isn’t just an inconvenience—it’s a chokehold on your ability to sell globally. COREMERCH solves this with sovereign commerce infrastructure designed for creators like you. No more depending on platforms that reject your transactions or lock you out. This guide walks you through deploying a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-how-bangladeshi-freelancers-accept-international-3|The Complete]] payment and delivery system using blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare infrastructure. By the end, you’ll own a fully operational online store that processes [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-which-architecture-actually-3|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-minimum-viable-stack|crypto]] payments automatically, delivers products instantly, and gives you full data ownership. No subscriptions. No hidden fees. Just infrastructure you control.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms fail creators in Ghana because they rely on centralized systems that discriminate based on geography. COREMERCH’s infrastructure bypasses this by leveraging decentralized tools. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your store for free. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic without servers. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers your digital products instantly. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a flat 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. This stack is built to withstand the exact conditions that shut down platforms like Stripe. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure. You own it. You control it. It works because it’s designed for the real-world challenges you face.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather these essentials: a domain name (optional but recommended), a NOWPayments account (free to set up), and your digital products ready for upload. If you’re using the Complete Builder Kit, you’ll get all templates and blueprints instantly. Familiarize yourself with the tools: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. No coding experience is required, but understanding how these pieces fit together will streamline deployment. COREMERCH provides step-by-step documentation and source code, so you’re never left guessing. This isn’t a black-box solution—it’s transparent infrastructure you can audit and customize.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring NOWPayments to accept crypto payments. Choose low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON to keep transaction costs under $0.10. Set up webhooks to trigger product delivery the moment payment confirms on-chain. Next, deploy your store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Link your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle orders and file delivery. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store your digital products securely. Test the entire pipeline end-to-end to ensure payments process correctly and products deliver instantly. The Complete Builder Kit includes all templates and blueprints, so you can skip trial and error. This pipeline is designed for reliability—no single point of failure, no geographic restrictions.
Own your infrastructure—no platform can shut you down.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your pipeline is tested, go live by pointing your domain to your hosted store. Share your product links with your audience and monitor your first transaction. NOWPayments will automatically verify the payment and fire the webhook to deliver the product. Your customer receives their purchase instantly, and you retain full control over your data and infrastructure. No platform fees. No delays. Just seamless transactions. After your first sale, review the process to ensure everything runs smoothly. COREMERCH’s 30-day support is available if you need assistance, but the infrastructure is designed to operate without ongoing intervention.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your infrastructure live, focus on scaling. Add more products to your store by uploading them to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and updating your backend logic. Use the scaling playbook included in the Complete Builder Kit to optimize performance as your customer base grows. Monitor transaction fees and adjust your preferred crypto networks if needed. Since you own the infrastructure, scaling doesn’t mean paying higher platform fees—it means expanding your reach. This system is built to grow with you, from your first sale to your thousandth. It’s not just a store—it’s a foundation for your digital business.

It uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook integration. This stack eliminates geographic restrictions and gives you full ownership of your store. Deploying it removes your dependence on platforms like Stripe or PayPal, ensuring you can sell globally without barriers.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Gather your domain name, NOWPayments account, and digital products. 2. Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Configure order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Upload your products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing and webhook triggers. 7. Test the entire pipeline end-to-end. 8. Deploy your store and point your domain. 9. Monitor your first transaction and ensure seamless delivery. 10. Scale by adding more products and optimizing performance.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I have no coding experience?
Yes. COREMERCH provides step-by-step documentation and templates designed for non-technical creators. The Complete Builder Kit includes everything you need to deploy without writing code.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Recommended low-fee networks include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transaction costs under $0.10.
Do I need to pay recurring fees for this infrastructure?
No. Once deployed, you own the infrastructure. There are no subscriptions or hidden fees—just a 0.5% transaction fee from NOWPayments.
Can I customize the store’s design and functionality?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes full source code, allowing you to customize your store’s design and backend logic to fit your brand.
What happens if I need support after deployment?
COREMERCH offers 30-day support for all stacks. The infrastructure is designed to operate without ongoing intervention, but assistance is available if needed.
